pages.text: Everything in Create turns. A water wheel or windmill spins shafts and cogwheels, and machines draw on that motion. Ask too much of a source and the whole line stalls. Engineer's Goggles show the strain.

$(li)$(l:crafting/create#crafting_kinetics_mechanical_press)Mechanical Press$(/l): sheets, and compacting over a basin.$(li)$(l:crafting/create#crafting_kinetics_mechanical_press)Mechanical Mixer$(/l) over a $(l:crafting/create#crafting_kinetics_basin)Basin$(/l): mixing, some of it needing heat.$(li)$(l:crafting/create#crafting_kinetics_basin)Millstone$(/l): crushed ore, which means more metal.
$(li)$(l:crafting/create#crafting_kinetics_encased_fan)Encased Fan$(/l): smelts through lava, washes through water, smokes through fire.$(br2)Hold $(l)W$() over a Create item to watch it work.
